title: "U 2 landing gear and pogos" – U-2 aircraft on lakebed (Chapter 2, p. 49)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 aircraft parked on a flat desert surface, showing its long slender wings supported by detachable wingtip "pogo" wheels, with a person standing near one wingtip. Captioned "U 2 landing gear and pogos." The accompanying text discusses the limits of World War II-era aerial cameras for high-altitude reconnaissance.
